# Memmy v1.2.4

## Highlights

- Improved OpenCode V2 conversation capture for continuous sessions and real-scan-first flows, with lifecycle completion, deduplication, and recoverable behavior while L3 is unavailable. WeChat capture now retries transient changes and cancels pending collection work on exit.
- Unified credential sources and account projection for BYOK and built-in model configuration, isolated connection-test responses after page unload, and preserved migrated model modes. Added model-thinking levels, token budgets, protocol selection, vision capability, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 capability registration.
- Improved Agent runtime Hook lifecycle handling, execution waits, OpenAI-compatible requests, model-error diagnostics, and tool-result handling. Explicit stop now replaces whole-turn timeout behavior, and resumed sessions continue with an explicit model selection.

## Agent and Desktop improvements

- Improved Memory reliability with cross-account candidate deduplication, Embedding input validation, failed-batch isolation, task-memory deletion, capture boundaries, and runtime builds with checksums for each platform artifact.
- Expanded the desktop experience with slash-command and subcommand suggestions, skill Markdown display, social-login entry points, model-thinking controls, and browser/computer-history authorization and recovery paths. Windows History and WeChat flows retain visible failures and their privacy boundaries.
- Unified Agent and Memory multi-platform runtime builds, version synchronization, and dependency-install scripts while keeping source, installer, and runtime metadata aligned.

## Upgrade notes

- Memmy Desktop and Agent are version `1.2.4`.
- The bundled Memory service, viewer, and CLI remain independently versioned. This file records the v1.2.4 product scope only.
- Real installation, in-place upgrade, and signed-release validation remain separate release gates. Full Harness regression, independent review, Draft PR, merge, signed tag, packaging, and publication are also separate gates.
